entities.name: Leon Biliński
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Leon Biliński was a Polish-Austrian statesman of the Biliński family. He had several important political functions in the Habsburg monarchy and independent Poland: He was President of Austrian State Railways (1893–1895), Minister of Finance of Austria and Minister of Finance of Austria-Hungary (1912–1915), Governor of the Austro-Hungarian Bank (1900–1909), Governor of Bosnia and Herzegovina (1912−1915), Minister of Finance of the Republic of Poland (1919), president of the Supreme National Committee (1914−1917) and Governor of Galicia (1895−1897).
